name: agent-link
description: Cross-host agent link: inspect, resolve, message, and audit Codex threads plus Claude Desktop and Claude Code sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, resolve, message, and audit Codex and Claude sessions
interface.longDescription: Agent Link gives agents one MCP surface for cross-host coordination. It lists, resolves, messages, and audits Codex threads plus Claude Desktop and Claude Code sessions. Claude delivery uses a pure-JS JSONL mailbox, Desktop hook/inbox visibility, and Claude Code Channel events when enabled. Both hosts share one receipt log at $CODEX_HOME/agent-link-receipts.jsonl. Cross-host messaging is first-class.
defaultPrompt: List recent Codex threads and Claude sessions
